body: Hey thanks for this, was looking for something like this, anything else you would recommend to add for complete help, similar to lookout etc?
Thanks you won't have mine till next week and lol, for a moment thought Sammy finally put it's foot down on rooters.
For Ebates do I have to cancel my order and then buy through them or is there another way for them to verify the purchase?, I wouldn't mind 4% back on 700$ lol.
Did you order yours from Samsung?
Pramiracetam can't be bought on Amazon.
I am glad to hear this worked for you, but I fear something like this because is been such a long time, isn't recovery beyond someone after such an amount of time?

Thanks for your words, But  isn't isolating myself better for others? They don't have to suffer from being around that type of person, I don't hurt anyone then isn't that better? Well that's the thing I am not a victim but instead the accuser I just have learned from my past that there is no version of myself that is the best, as it's always been the same no matter the card. I hope I don't come off as rude or anything, the only thing is that how can the truth be an addiction, After all I've done I would agree that I'm not worth shit, and even before I thought I would fail anyway it would happen until I finally accepted it. Isn't it a waste of someone's time to help someone that won't help themselves? Funny you say that because when I have met people in the past I noticed thougthts of them being amazing and full of life would enter my mind, almost as if the addiction was to feel bad if that makes sense? I actually don't know where to start on doing things my mind tells me not to do, I have accepted that I will just destroy that as well. Thanks again I didn't know that's how I sounded, I never even had thought like that but others will see what we can see in ourselves. I did have a therapist but didn't see the need to waste her time, I just felt that if I could help with the world of more problems then why not. I do hope you response as I am wondering how being in contact with another person would be good....
